annotations.title: Exclude searches on Microsoft Advertising (negative keywords)

description: EXCLUDE searches from a Microsoft Advertising campaign or ad group with negative keywords — Exact or Phrase only (Microsoft has no broad negative; default Phrase, which blocks every search containing the phrase), up to 20,000 per campaign or ad group. Broad-match keywords without negatives are the classic way to waste money: “stop paying for free” is this tool. It can only narrow spend, so it is never confirm-gated. Read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

campaignId.description: campaign to add negatives to; pass this or adGroupId

keywords.description: negative keywords, each with text and matchType (Exact or Phrase)

matchType.description: default Phrase — Microsoft has no broad negative
